analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 85,995) vs SMA5 (KRW 99,207) / SMA20 (KRW 99,207) / SMA50 (KRW 104,149): below short/mid-term trends, indicating bearish position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 112,710) / SMA200 (KRW 100,090): below mid/long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.
· 52-week position (32.5%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.0→30.5) + entering oversold territory + suggesting potential slowdown in decline.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-5911.8191→-1402.8691) + improving diagnosis + signal of continued weakness.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 78,163) + band width at 42.42% indicating high volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 85,300) + support zone based on Pivot S1 (KRW 74,592).
· Swing resistance (KRW 89,580) + resistance zone below 5-day high (KRW 91,390).
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern (Lower High continuation) + bearish trend interpretation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x) + lethargic movement, reduced confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) + presenting conditions for observation after confirming support at KRW 85,300.

keyPointsEn: RSI at 30.5 entering oversold territory, opening possibility for short-term rebound.
MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative, trend reversal unconfirmed.
ADX at 31.9 maintains a clear trend, with -DI dominance indicating continued downward pressure.
Five consecutive down days, potential for further decline if 85,300 support breaks.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 31.9로 뚜렷한 추세 유지 중이며 -DI가 +DI 대비 우위인 상황에서 RSI 과매도 탈출 시도가 위장 반등일 가능성 상존.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 31.9 indicating a clear trend and -DI outperforming +DI, the RSI oversold exit attempt carries the risk of being a bear trap.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 유지. 금일 RSI 30.5로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 개선세 보이나 여전히 음수 구간으로, 추세 전환 신호 미확인. ADX 31.9로 추세 강화 지속. 85,300원 지지선 하향 이탈 시 추가 하락 가능성으로 관망 유지.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading sessions. Today, RSI entered oversold territory at 30.5, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it remains negative, with no confirmed trend reversal signal. ADX at 31.9 continues to strengthen the trend. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to the potential for further decline if the 85,300 support level breaks.
